verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no LibreOffice sandbox or test environment for exercising automation separately from real data. Related features are adjacent, not this capability: --safe-mode is a troubleshooting profile reset, -env sets a non-default profile path, and --view opens files read-only. Using these for isolation would be a user-side workaround.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
